scope: MicroClay Stage-A adaptive memory entry-point learning

observed_problem.main_behavior: Adaptive scoring could only rerank memories with baseline lexical support because zero-baseline candidates were filtered from both serving and shadow selection.
observed_problem.consequence: MicroClay could learn weights but could not actually learn a new entry point that opens a prior lexical miss.
observed_problem.old_pr_415_donor: PR #415 already proposed query-cue to subject routes, but it is a large diverged Stage-A/Stage-B/terminal fusion candidate and retained POLICY_VERSION=1 across changed adaptive semantics.

candidate_delta: POLICY_VERSION advances to 2 for the new adaptive routing semantics.
All new entry-policy keys are version-scoped so persisted v1 capital cannot silently affect v2 behavior.
A persisted ACTIVE mode with a different policy_version is treated as SHADOW until exact v2 promotion.
Bounded hashed query-only cue -> subject route keys can acquire capital only from actually served evidence that later receives canonical causal outcome credit.
Only positive learned route capital can open a zero-lexical adaptive candidate.
Generic kind/subject capital cannot open a lexical miss.
New route credit is limited to rank-1 served evidence to reduce alias spraying across a full retrieved pack.
SHADOW remains factual serving authority: learned routes may appear in shadow_memory_ids without changing PRESENT/UNKNOWN serving status.

covered: v1 ACTIVE state fails closed to SHADOW under v2 code
exact v2 policy state can expose ACTIVE mode
positive learned route opens adaptive packing only
baseline serving does not open the route
generic subject capital cannot open a miss
negative learned route capital cannot open a miss
mechanism_regression.boundary: Exact candidate microclay_retrieval.py with a minimal SQLite/stub authority surface; not full repository pytest.

counterhypotheses_and_open_gates: A learned cue->subject route may overfit aliases or amplify stale subject structure even though it cannot change truth; held-out contamination/staleness/negative-correction tests are required before ACTIVE promotion.
Current automatic reward remains dominated by verified effect outcomes; explicit correction/retrieval-miss feedback remains an open product gate.

The focused candidate intentionally does not fuse PR #415 Stage-B method-memory semantics; Stage-B should remain on the retained strict authority/admission line rather than creating a second retrieval truth path.

Replay full-request identity, crash-atomic learning and Stage-A method/control-kind isolation remain separate fusion obligations and require current-head adjudication before a final combined MicroClay promotion candidate.

go_experiment_accounting.reason: The shared user-trigger metadata available to this organ is minute precision only and no immutable request/turn id is exposed; current BOOTSTRAP_MINIMAL schema 5.2 requires fail-closed no unusual experiment.

next_exact_gate: Refresh/fuse current main, run the focused test plus adjacent MicroClay replay/credit/context/recovery regressions in an actually-started authorized isolated exact checkout, then held-out SHADOW-vs-baseline alias/contamination/stale-route evaluation before any ACTIVE promotion.
